mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(entry_type='RESERVE'),0) AS reserves, COALESCE(SUM(entry_type='CONFIRM'),0) AS confirms, COALESCE(SUM(entry_type='RELEASE'),0) AS releases, COALESCE(SUM(delta_available),0) AS available_delta, COALESCE(SUM(delta_reserved),0) AS reserved_delta, COALESCE(SUM(delta_issued),0) AS issued_delta FROM stock_ledger WHERE campaign_id=#{campaignId}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS vouchers,COALESCE(SUM(status='USED'),0) AS used FROM user_vouchers WHERE campaign_id=#{campaignId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM redemption_records r JOIN user_vouchers v ON v.id=r.voucher_id WHERE v.campaign_id=#{campaignId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fulfillment_orders o WHERE o.campaign_id=#{campaignId} AND ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_ledger l WHERE l.order_id=o.id AND l.entry_type='RESERVE') != 1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_ledger l WHERE l.order_id=o.id AND l.campaign_id != o.campaign_id) OR (o.status='FULFILLED' AND ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_ledger l WHERE l.order_id=o.id AND l.entry_type='CONFIRM') != 1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_ledger l WHERE l.order_id=o.id AND l.entry_type='RELEASE') OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_vouchers v WHERE v.order_id=o.id) != 1)) OR (o.status='FAILED' AND ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_ledger l WHERE l.order_id=o.id AND l.entry_type='RELEASE') != 1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_ledger l WHERE l.order_id=o.id AND l.entry_type='CONFIRM') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_vouchers v WHERE v.order_id=o.id))) OR (o.status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN') AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_ledger l WHERE l.order_id=o.id AND l.entry_type IN ('CONFIRM','RELEASE')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_vouchers v WHERE v.order_id=o.id)))
OR (o.fulfillment_mode='SUPPLIER' AND o.status IN ('FULFILLED','FAILED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stock_ledger l JOIN supplier_receipts r ON r.id=l.source_receipt_id WHERE l.order_id=o.id AND r.order_id=o.id AND r.supplier_id=o.supplier_id AND r.request_no=o.request_no AND r.product_code=o.product_code AND r.subject_ref=o.subject_ref AND r.id=o.last_accepted_receipt_id AND r.result_version=o.last_result_version AND r.apply_state='APPLIED' AND ((o.status='FULFILLED' AND l.entry_type='CONFIRM' AND r.status='SUCCEEDED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_vouchers v WHERE v.order_id=o.id AND v.supplier_voucher_ref=r.voucher_ref)) OR (o.status='FAILED' AND l.entry_type='RELEASE' AND r.status='REJECTED' AND r.voucher_ref IS NULL)) AND ((r.source IN ('WORKER','CALLBACK') AND l.repair_command_id IS NULL) OR (r.source='REPAIR_QUERY' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM repair_commands rc WHERE rc.command_id=l.repair_command_id AND rc.order_id=o.id AND rc.result IS NOT NULL AND rc.operation=CASE WHEN o.status='FULFILLED' THEN 'CONFIRM' ELSE 'RELEASE' END))) )) )) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_vouchers v JOIN fulfillment_orders o ON o.id=v.order_id WHERE (v.campaign_id=#{campaignId} OR o.campaign_id=#{campaignId}) AND ( v.campaign_id != o.campaign_id OR v.user_id != o.user_id OR v.expires_at != o.expires_at OR o.status != 'FULFILLED' OR (v.status='USED' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM redemption_records r WHERE r.voucher_id=v.id) != 1) OR (v.status='UNUSED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM redemption_records r WHERE r.voucher_id=v.id)) ))
